messages:
maya: quick question — current embeds endpoint behavior when a single request contains mixed-dimension items? docs just say 'batching supported' but console shows a 'dim-splitting' hint. do we auto-split, reject, or route? :thinking:
kevin: today router will auto-split by dim and send multiple downstream requests. we also respect MAX_BATCH_BYTES and MAX_ITEMS. we don't transcode vectors. routing creates separate downstream calls per dim.
sam: that auto-split causes two problems: quota attribution is fuzzy and console billing estimates are wrong for customers. if a single request produces 2 downstream calls who gets charged and how is it shown in the dashboard?
olivia: UX thought: show a preflight estimate in the console + SDK: "estimated requests: 2, estimated charge-units: 3.4" and a toggle to opt-in to auto-split. otherwise fail-fast.
kevin: implementation detail — we sketched a /v1/embeds/preflight endpoint that runs the splitter logic without committing. example payload:
```http
POST /v1/embeds/preflight
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "items": [ {"text":"...","dim":1536}, {"text":"...","dim":768} ]
}
```
Preflight returns planned routing and charge estimate.
sam: preflight is great but can't be on hot path for every request. we should cache preflight results by shape/signature and let SDK call it optionally for interactive UIs.
nana: (typo) sorry, ana: telemetry needs: embed.route.splits.count with tags {dim, split_policy}, embed.quota.charge_units per request, and preflight.id to join traces. console dashboards should link to traces for failed requests.
infra-bot: deploy scheduled: embed-splitter-rollout v1 -> canary 10% @ 3755554300
olivia: for the canary we should expose a console flag showing which requests were handled by the canary split logic and an "impact estimate" tile (affected requests, avg charge delta). also add a "why my request failed" debug link that includes the preflight id.
kevin: edge-case: extremely large payloads (>EMBED_MAX_BYTES) currently return 413 with header `X-Embed-Reason: payload-too-large` and `Retry-After`. we could change to stream-fail where we accept then fail individual items, but that complicates billing.
sam: proposal: default server behavior -> fail-fast on mixed dims unless client opts-in with header `X-Embed-AutoSplit: true`. that keeps cost predictable and avoids surprise double-charges for naive clients.
maya: strong +1 for opt-in fail-fast default. predictable failures are easier to debug than phantom charges. :thumbsup:
olivia: SDK change: redwood.embeds.client({autoSplit: true}) default false for now. console quickstart shows toggle per-API-key and per-route.
nana: (ana) I'll sync with analytics to add preflight metrics and create dashboard tiles: "Embeds: split rate", "Embeds: avg charge-units", "Embeds: preflight hit ratio".
kevin: i'll draft the router PR to honor the opt-in header and emit new telemetry tags, and add preflight endpoint. will also add a small console tile for the canary showing split-rate by dim. assigning to kevin.
maya: filing follow-ups: INFR-934 create preflight endpoint, INFR-935 console estimate tile + toggle, INFR-936 SDK opt-in header + docs (link to tickets). thanks all.
deploybot: canary 10% completed @3755554360 — monitoring shows latency +0.2ms, split error rate 0.0% so far.
kevin: placing a note in the changelog and will add docs section: "Embeddings: mixed-dim behavior and opt-in auto-split".
maya: perfect. we'll revisit after metrics in 24h.
